# TTS Audio Step Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add step 2 "Audio" to each project: one TTS clip per scene (OmniVoice or VoxCPM2, cloned from a voice library), generated by a separate ML worker that runs on the Mac or on a Windows PC, and make the whole app runnable on Windows.

**Architecture:** The FastAPI backend stays torch-free: it owns the voice library, an in-memory-leased audio queue stored in each `project.json`, and an HTTP API for workers. A new `worker-tts/` process with its own Python 3.10 venv (`.venv-ml`) polls that API, loads one model at a time on CUDA/MPS/CPU, and uploads trimmed WAV clips. The React project page gets a step bar (`/project/<id>/images|audio|export`) and a new Audio view.

**Tech Stack:** FastAPI + pydantic (backend, stdlib `wave`/`sqlite3`, ffmpeg CLI), React 19 + Tailwind + lucide-react (frontend), Python 3.10 + torch 2.8.0 + `omnivoice==0.2.1` + `voxcpm` + numpy 1.26.4 + soundfile (worker).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-30-tts-audio-step-design.md`

**Reference project (read-only, copy patterns from it):** `/Users/rogersovich/Documents/Coding/Python/manhwa-recap-studio`, mainly `worker-ml/engines/tts_engine.py` (OmniVoice at `:869-990`, VoxCPM2 at `:1042-1400`, `studio_clean_master` at `:1002`, `crossfade_concat` at `:114`) and `worker-ml/remote.py`.

## Global Constraints

- The backend (`backend/`) never imports torch, numpy or any ML package. Everything ML lives in `worker-tts/`.
- Only two models: ids `omnivoice` (repo `k2-fsa/OmniVoice`, 24 kHz) and `voxcpm2` (repo `openbmb/VoxCPM2`, 48 kHz).
- Worker venv: Python 3.10, `torch==2.8.0`, `torchaudio==2.8.0`, `numpy==1.26.4`, `omnivoice==0.2.1`; `voxcpm` installed by the setup scripts (unpinned, as in the reference project).
- Device order: CUDA → MPS → CPU. OmniVoice: fp16 on CUDA, fp32 on MPS/CPU. VoxCPM2: TF32 + `set_float32_matmul_precision("high")` on CUDA. Always set `PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1`; set `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True` before importing torch.
- Only one model loaded per worker at a time; unload after 600 s idle.
- Reference voice audio: 1 to 11.5 s, stored as mono 48 kHz WAV (ffmpeg).
- Regenerating a scene always uses a new random seed (never fall back to 42).
- VoxCPM2: append "." when text has no final punctuation in `.!?,;:"'…`; never append "...". No speed stretching for VoxCPM2 (the reference project's `F5Narrator._apply_speed` call is a bug).
- Heartbeat every 20 s, lease 120 s, worker counts as online if seen in the last 30 s.
- Audio clips: leading/trailing silence trimmed, keeping 50 ms margin; stored duration = duration of the trimmed file.
- Language map: project language "Indonesia" → `id`, "English" → `en`, anything else → `id`.
- All user-facing copy is Indonesian, matching existing UI tone.
- Everything must run on Windows as well as macOS: use `pathlib`, no shell-only tools in Python, launcher scripts for both.
- Project data is not synced between machines.

## Review Focus

1. A scene whose narration is empty or whitespace: "Generate" must not send it to a worker; it becomes `failed` with error "Narasi kosong" (test in Task 3).
2. The selected voice is deleted while scenes are queued: the next claim of such a scene fails that scene with "Suara tidak ditemukan" instead of crashing the worker loop (test in Task 3).
3. The narration is edited while its clip is being generated: the uploaded result is saved but shows as stale, because the key was taken at claim time (test in Task 3).
4. The backend restarts while scenes are `generating`: leases are in memory only, so on startup every `generating` audio scene goes back to `queued` (test in Task 3).
5. Two workers claim at the same moment: they never receive the same scene (test in Task 3).

### Task 3: Audio queue core (backend)

**Files:**
- Create: `backend/app/audio.py`
- Test: `backend/tests/test_audio.py` (extend)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `storage`, `settings`, `voices.get`, models from Task 1.
- Produces (`audio.py`):
  - `lang_code(language: str) -> str` (map in Global Constraints)
  - `resolve(p: Project) -> tuple[str | None, TtsModel]`: `(p.voice_id or settings.tts_voice_id, p.tts_model or settings.tts_model)`
  - `audio_key(narration: str, voice_id: str | None, model: str) -> str`: first 16 hex chars of sha1 of `f"{model}\n{voice_id}\n{narration.strip()}"`
  - `is_stale(p: Project, s: Scene) -> bool`: `s.audio_status == "done" and s.audio_key != audio_key(s.narration, *resolve(p))`
  - `enqueue(project_id: str, mode: Literal["missing", "all"], indices: list[int] | None = None) -> Project`: raises `ValueError("Pilih suara dulu")` if no voice resolves, `ValueError("Suara tidak ditemukan")` if `voices.get` is None, `ValueError("Project masih draft")` for drafts. Targets = `indices` if given else all scenes. `missing` queues targets whose status is `pending`/`failed` or that are stale; `all` queues every target not currently `generating`. Empty narration → `failed`, `audio_error="Narasi kosong"`, not queued. Clears `audio_error` on queued scenes.
  - `pause(project_id: str) -> Project`: every `queued` scene → `pending`.
  - `heartbeat(name: str, models: list[str], device: str, is_local: bool) -> None`: updates the in-memory registry `{name: {"models", "device", "local", "seen"}}` and extends that worker's leases.
  - `workers_status() -> list[dict]`: `{"name", "device", "models", "local", "online"}` with `online = seen within TTS_SEEN_SECONDS`.
  - `claim(name: str, models: list[str], is_local: bool) -> dict | None`: calls `reap()`; applies `TTS_WORKER_MODE` (`remote`: local workers get None; `auto`: local workers drop models offered by any online non-local worker); walks projects oldest-first and scenes in order for the first `queued` scene whose resolved model is in the allowed list. If its voice no longer exists → mark `failed` "Suara tidak ditemukan" and continue. Marks it `generating`, sets `audio_started_at`, `audio_worker`, a new seed `random.randint(1, 2**31 - 1)`, records the lease `{(project_id, index): (name, expires)}` and returns `{"project_id", "scene_index", "text", "lang", "voice_id", "voice_version", "voice_transcript", "model", "params", "seed", "key"}` where `voice_version` = `int(ref.wav mtime)` and `params` = the model's settings block as dict.
  - `save_result(project_id: str, index: int, name: str, key: str, data: bytes) -> Project`: `PermissionError` if the lease is not held by `name` (stale/reaped); `ValueError` if `data` is not RIFF/WAVE; writes `audio/scene_{index+1:03d}.wav`, sets `done`, `audio_file="audio/scene_NNN.wav"`, `audio_duration` from `wave` (frames / rate, rounded to 3 decimals), `audio_key=key`, drops the lease.
  - `fail(project_id: str, index: int, name: str, error: str) -> Project`: same lease check; `failed` with error truncated to 500 chars.
  - `reap() -> int`: scenes whose lease expired go back to `queued`; returns count.
  - `reset_on_startup() -> int`: every `generating` audio scene in every project → `queued`; returns count.
  - All mutations under `storage.lock`.

### Task 4: Audio HTTP API, auth, trusted network, ZIP and Windows-safe file routes

**Files:**
- Create: `backend/app/routes_audio.py`
- Modify: `backend/app/main.py`
- Test: `backend/tests/test_audio_routes.py`; extend `backend/tests/test_flow.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `voices.*` (Task 2), `audio.*` (Task 3).
- Produces HTTP (all JSON unless noted; errors map `ValueError`→400, `LookupError`→404, `PermissionError`→409):
  - UI: `GET /api/voices` → `Voice[]`; `POST /api/voices` (`VoiceIn`) → `Voice`; `DELETE /api/voices/{id}` → 204; `GET /api/voices/{id}/audio` → wav; `POST /api/voices/import-legacy` → `{"imported": n}` (404 with clear message if the legacy db is missing).
  - UI: `PUT /api/projects/{id}/tts` (`ProjectTtsIn`) → project; `POST /api/projects/{id}/audio/generate` (`AudioGenerateIn`) → project; `POST /api/projects/{id}/audio/pause` → project; `GET /api/tts/status` → `{"mode", "workers": workers_status(), "queued": n, "generating": n}`.
  - Files: `GET /files/{project_id}/audio/{name}` (only `scene_\d{3}\.wav`).
  - Worker (`/api/tts-worker`): `POST /heartbeat` (`WorkerHelloIn`) → 204; `POST /claim` (`WorkerHelloIn`) → job or 204; `GET /voices/{id}/audio` → wav; `PUT /jobs/{project_id}/{index}/result?key=<key>` with raw `audio/wav` body and header `X-Worker-Name` → 204; `POST /jobs/{project_id}/{index}/fail` (`WorkerFailIn`, header `X-Worker-Name`) → 204.
  - Worker auth dependency `require_worker(request) -> bool` (returns `is_local`): loopback clients (`127.0.0.1`, `::1`) pass without a token and are local; others need `Authorization: Bearer <TTS_WORKER_TOKEN>` checked with `secrets.compare_digest`; if `TTS_WORKER_TOKEN` is empty, non-loopback calls get 404.
  - Middleware `trusted_network`: for paths not starting with `/api/tts-worker`, reject clients outside loopback, `100.64.0.0/10` and `fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48` with 403 (only matters when `HOST=0.0.0.0`).
- `main.py` changes: `app.include_router(routes_audio.router)`; add the middleware; lifespan calls `audio.reset_on_startup()`; `_out` adds `out["audio_stale"] = audio.is_stale(p, scene)`; ZIP writes `audio/scene_NNN.wav` for scenes with an `audio_file`; `GET /files/{project_id}/{name}` also rejects names containing `\`.

### Task 5: Worker text and audio utilities

**Files:**
- Create: `worker-tts/requirements.txt`, `worker-tts/textprep.py`, `worker-tts/audio.py`, `worker-tts/tests/test_textprep.py`, `worker-tts/tests/test_audio.py`, `worker-tts/setup-worker.sh`, `worker-tts/setup-worker.ps1`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces (`textprep.py`): `normalize_numbers(text: str, lang: str) -> str` (digits/decimals → words via `num2words(n, lang=lang)`; keep text otherwise); `split_sentences(text: str, max_chars: int = 200) -> list[str]` (split on `.!?` followed by space, merge short pieces up to `max_chars`, split an over-long sentence at the last `,`/`;`/space before `max_chars`; never returns empty strings); `prepare(text: str, lang: str, model: str) -> list[str]` = normalize, split, and for `voxcpm2` append "." to each piece lacking final punctuation (Global Constraints).
- Produces (`audio.py`): `concat(waves: list[np.ndarray], sr: int, crossfade_s: float = 0.05) -> np.ndarray`; `trim_silence(wave: np.ndarray, sr: int, threshold_db: float = -45.0, margin_s: float = 0.05) -> np.ndarray` (returns input unchanged if everything is below threshold); `to_wav_bytes(wave: np.ndarray, sr: int) -> bytes` (PCM_16 via soundfile).
- `requirements.txt`: `torch==2.8.0`, `torchaudio==2.8.0`, `numpy==1.26.4`, `soundfile>=0.12`, `num2words==0.5.14`, `huggingface_hub`, `python-dotenv>=1.0`, `omnivoice==0.2.1`, `pytest>=8`.
- `setup-worker.sh` (macOS): find `python3.10` (fail with a brew hint if missing), create `worker-tts/.venv-ml`, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, then `pip install voxcpm` (warn, don't fail, if it fails). `setup-worker.ps1` (Windows): `py -3.10 -m venv worker-tts\.venv-ml`, install `torch==2.8.0 torchaudio==2.8.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128` first, then `-r requirements.txt`, then `voxcpm`.

  - `test_split_long_text`: 3 sentences totalling ~450 chars → every piece `<= 200` chars and `"".join` of pieces (spaces normalised) equals the input.

### Task 6: Worker engines, device detection and run loop

**Files:**
- Create: `worker-tts/settings.py`, `worker-tts/device.py`, `worker-tts/engines.py`, `worker-tts/client.py`, `worker-tts/main.py`, `worker-tts/download_models.py`, `worker-tts/.env.example`, `worker-tts/run-worker.bat`, `worker-tts/README.md`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: HTTP API from Task 4; `textprep.prepare`, `audio.concat/trim_silence/to_wav_bytes` (Task 5).
- Produces:
  - `settings.py`: loads `worker-tts/.env`; `SERVER` (`TTS_SERVER`, default `http://127.0.0.1:8000`), `TOKEN` (`TTS_WORKER_TOKEN`), `NAME` (`TTS_WORKER_NAME`, default `socket.gethostname()`), `HF_CACHE` (`TTS_HF_CACHE`, default `worker-tts/models/hf_cache`; may point at the reference project's cache), `VOXCPM_OPTIMIZE` (default false), `IDLE_UNLOAD_SECONDS = 600`.
  - `device.py`: `pick_device() -> str` (`"cuda:0" | "mps" | "cpu"`); `describe_device() -> str` (e.g. `"CUDA · NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060"`, `"MPS · Apple Silicon"`, `"CPU"`). Sets the env vars in Global Constraints at import, before importing torch.
  - `engines.py`: `installed_models() -> list[str]` (via `importlib.util.find_spec("omnivoice")` / `"voxcpm"`); classes `OmniVoiceEngine` and `VoxCPM2Engine`, each with `model_id: str`, `sr: int`, `load() -> None`, `set_reference(ref_wav: Path, transcript: str) -> None`, `generate(text: str, seed: int, params: dict) -> np.ndarray`, `unload() -> None`; `get_engine(model_id: str)` returns a cached instance and unloads any other loaded engine first. Port loading, dtype, voice-clone prompt reuse, safetensors-on-CPU patch, CUDA-graph `empty_cache` rule and `studio_clean_master` from the reference file (`:869-990`, `:1002`, `:1042-1400`); drop LoRA, singing, Whisper unloading and speed stretching for VoxCPM2. OmniVoice fixed params: `class_temperature=0`, `position_temperature=5`, `language=<job lang>`; tunable: `num_step`, `guidance_scale`, `t_shift`, `speed` (pass `speed` only when ≠ 1.0).
  - `client.py`: `Client(server, token, name)` with `heartbeat(models, device)`, `claim(models) -> dict | None`, `voice_audio(voice_id) -> bytes`, `put_result(project_id, index, key, wav: bytes)`, `fail(project_id, index, error)`; stdlib `urllib`; raises `Offline` on connection errors and `NotOurs` on HTTP 409.
  - `main.py`: `python worker-tts/main.py` starts: a heartbeat thread every 20 s; loop: `claim` → if job: get engine, set reference from cache `worker-tts/cache/voices/<voice_id>_<voice_version>.wav` (download once), `prepare` text, generate each piece with the job seed, `concat` → `trim_silence` → `put_result`; on exception call `fail` with the message and continue; if no job sleep 2 s; on `Offline` sleep 10 s and retry; unload the engine after `IDLE_UNLOAD_SECONDS` idle; Ctrl+C finishes the current scene then exits. Logs one line per scene: `[scene 12] omnivoice 3.4s audio in 5.1s (MPS)`.
  - `download_models.py <omnivoice|voxcpm2|all>`: pre-downloads repo files into `HF_CACHE` (file lists from the reference file `:810-830`).
